lines.zh: 我踩断树枝，声音替我报信。
lines.en: I snap a branch and the sound announces me.

lines.zh: 森林很密，我用肩膀开路。
lines.en: The forest is thick, so I shoulder my way through.

lines.zh: 雪地上一串大脚印，是我的。
lines.en: A line of big prints in the snow belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我一步接一步，走一天也不歇。
lines.en: One step after another, and I do not rest all day.

lines.zh: 针叶刮过我的背，我不在意。
lines.en: Needles scrape my back and I do not care.

lines.zh: 我闻到前面有活物，脚步就快了。
lines.en: I smell something alive ahead and quicken my pace.

lines.zh: 树倒在我旁边，我绕过去继续走。
lines.en: A tree falls beside me; I walk around it and go on.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌很宽，压不陷进泥里。
lines.en: My soles are wide and do not sink into the mud.

lines.zh: 我在林子里转圈，最后总会撞上猎物。
lines.en: I circle the woods and always end up at prey.

lines.zh: 苔藓被我踩出汁水，绿了一片。
lines.en: Moss squelches under my feet and stains them green.

lines.zh: 我不躲树，树躲我。
lines.en: I do not dodge trees; trees dodge me.

lines.zh: 走到林子尽头，我就知道该回头了。
lines.en: At the forest edge I know it is time to turn back.

lines.zh: 我坐在倒木上，把背靠得很实。
lines.en: I sit on a fallen trunk with my back set firm.

lines.zh: 我抓了抓胸口，那里痒。
lines.en: I scratch my chest; something itches there.

lines.zh: 森林里安静，只有我的呼吸粗。
lines.en: The forest is quiet except for my heavy breathing.

lines.zh: 我在想事，可我想不明白。
lines.en: I am thinking something through, and cannot finish it.

lines.zh: 二十五点生命在我身体里滚。
lines.en: Twenty-five points of life churn inside this body.

lines.zh: 我把手指插进土里，感觉踏实。
lines.en: I push my fingers into the soil and feel steady.

lines.zh: 头顶有鸟叫，我懒得抬头。
lines.en: Birds call overhead and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我不需要聪明，我只需要站着。
lines.en: I do not need cleverness; I need to stand.

lines.zh: 雪落在我肩上，一会就化了。
lines.en: Snow lands on my shoulders and melts away.

lines.zh: 我在等天黑，或者等谁来。
lines.en: I wait for nightfall, or for someone to come.

lines.zh: 你比林子里的鹿小，也比鹿慢。
lines.en: You are smaller than a deer and slower too.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，想不通你是什么。
lines.en: I tilt my head at you and cannot work out what you are.

lines.zh: 你的衣服很薄，扛不住这一下。
lines.en: Your clothes are thin and will not survive a blow.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，看它有没有棍子。
lines.en: I watch your hands for a club.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，我往前了一步。
lines.en: You take one step back; I take one forward.

lines.zh: 你眼睛动得很快，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Your eyes move quickly, and I dislike that.

lines.zh: 我记住你的味道了，混着铁。
lines.en: I have your scent now, mixed with iron.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，膝盖在抖。
lines.en: Your knees shake while you look at me.

lines.zh: 我低下头，是想看清你有多高。
lines.en: I lower my head to measure how tall you are.

lines.zh: 我本来不想理你，可你站着不走。
lines.en: I meant to ignore you, but you will not leave.

lines.zh: 疼，我吼一声，声音传得很远。
lines.en: It hurts; I roar and the sound carries far.

lines.zh: 你打穿了我的皮，也就到这了。
lines.en: You broke my hide, and no further.

lines.zh: 我二十五点的生命，还没用完。
lines.en: Twenty-five points of life, not yet spent.

lines.zh: 这一下让我更想砸碎你。
lines.en: That blow only makes me want to crush you.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，接着又上前一步。
lines.en: I give half a step, then take one back.

lines.zh: 我的血滴在雪上，很显眼。
lines.en: My blood on the snow is very visible.

lines.zh: 你伤到我了，你运气不错。
lines.en: You hurt me; you had good luck.

lines.zh: 我拿手按住伤口，继续走。
lines.en: I press a hand to the wound and keep walking.

lines.zh: 我疼得忘了要打哪里。
lines.en: The pain makes me forget where to hit.

lines.zh: 下一拳我会用尽全力。
lines.en: The next punch will use everything I have.

lines.zh: 你手里的肉很香，我闻到了。
lines.en: The meat in your hand smells good and I catch it.

lines.zh: 我不吃你给的，我要自己抢。
lines.en: I do not take what you offer; I take it myself.

lines.zh: 你把面包举起来，我只看见你的手。
lines.en: You lift the bread, and I only see your hand.

lines.zh: 我饿，但我更想打你。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I would rather hit you.

lines.zh: 食物放在地上，我踩了过去。
lines.en: The food lies on the ground and I step over it.

lines.zh: 那种甜味，林子里没有。
lines.en: That sweetness does not grow in this forest.

lines.zh: 我伸手去够，够不到就算了。
lines.en: I reach for it and let it go if I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 你晃那块肉，我的牙就露出来了。
lines.en: You swing the meat and my teeth show.

lines.zh: 我闻着味走，走成了直线。
lines.en: I follow the smell in a straight line.

lines.zh: 吃的东西我自己会找，不用你教。
lines.en: I find my own food and need no lessons from you.

lines.zh: 我一撞，你就退了半步。
lines.en: One shove from me and you stagger half a step.

lines.zh: 你撞在我胸口，像撞在一棵树上。
lines.en: You hit my chest like hitting a tree.

lines.zh: 我没让路，我从不给人让路。
lines.en: I did not step aside; I never step aside.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀擦过你的，骨头都响了。
lines.en: My shoulder grazes yours and bones creak.

lines.zh: 你被弹开，我连头都没回。
lines.en: You are knocked away and I do not even turn my head.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，倒的是你。
lines.en: We collide, and you are the one who falls.

lines.zh: 我的身体比你想的重得多。
lines.en: This body is far heavier than you assume.

lines.zh: 别从我面前横穿，我停不下来。
lines.en: Do not cross in front of me; I cannot stop.

lines.zh: 我把你顶到树干上，树晃了。
lines.en: I pin you to a trunk and the tree shakes.

lines.zh: 撞完这一下，我才开始生气。
lines.en: Only after that collision do I start to get angry.

lines.zh: 林子里还有另一个大脚印，是她的。
lines.en: There are other big prints here, and they are hers.

lines.zh: 我不送花，我送一头猎物。
lines.en: I bring no flowers; I bring a kill.

lines.zh: 她比我高半个头，我认了。
lines.en: She stands half a head taller and I accept it.

lines.zh: 我们隔着树互相吼，就算说完了。
lines.en: We roar across the trees and that is the whole talk.

lines.zh: 配对季节，森林里到处都是吼声。
lines.en: In season the forest is full of roaring.

lines.zh: 我给她梳背上的毛，用我的手指。
lines.en: I comb the fur on her back with my fingers.

lines.zh: 她走了，我跟着走了三天。
lines.en: She left and I followed for three days.

lines.zh: 我们的脚印并排，谁也踩不到谁。
lines.en: Our prints run side by side and never overlap.

lines.zh: 我笨，可我知道要护着她。
lines.en: I am dull, but I know to guard her.

lines.zh: 一大一小两团影子进了林子深处。
lines.en: Two shadows, one large one small, go deep into the woods.

lines.zh: 我捡起一根树干，比棍子好用。
lines.en: I pick up a trunk; it beats a stick.

lines.zh: 石头我拿一块就够了。
lines.en: One stone is all I need to carry.

lines.zh: 我把骨头塞进腰间，留着磨牙。
lines.en: I tuck a bone at my waist to gnaw later.

lines.zh: 那东西太小，我捏了半天才捏住。
lines.en: That thing is so small I fumble to pinch it.

lines.zh: 我捡到的都往洞里搬。
lines.en: Everything I pick up goes into the cave.

lines.zh: 你的剑掉了，我替你捡起来。
lines.en: You dropped your sword, so I pick it up for you.

lines.zh: 我把木头扛在肩上，压得土响。
lines.en: I shoulder the timber and the ground creaks.

lines.zh: 为了把东西带走，我得弯下腰。
lines.en: To carry it off, I have to bend down low.

lines.zh: 我拿着它看了很久，还是不懂。
lines.en: I hold it a long time and still do not understand.

lines.zh: 这个归我了，你可以走了。
lines.en: This is mine now, so you may go.

lines.zh: 我闻到活物的热气，头就转过去了。
lines.en: I smell warm breath and my head turns toward it.

lines.zh: 树林里跑的东西，都是我的。
lines.en: Whatever runs in these woods is mine.

lines.zh: 我听见你的脚步，比我轻太多。
lines.en: I hear your steps; they are far lighter than mine.

lines.zh: 我认准了，就不换目标。
lines.en: Once I have chosen, I never change targets.

lines.zh: 你还在臂展外，我已经开始走了。
lines.en: You are still out of reach and I am already walking.

lines.zh: 我看到你的时候，喉咙先响了。
lines.en: When I see you, my throat growls first.

lines.zh: 那只鹿跑了，我改主意了，是你。
lines.en: The deer fled; I changed my mind; it is you.

lines.zh: 我闻到了铁和汗，两样都好。
lines.en: I smell iron and sweat, and both will do.

lines.zh: 你藏在树后，可树挡不住味道。
lines.en: You hide behind a tree, but a tree hides no smell.

lines.zh: 我不喊，我只是开始走。
lines.en: I do not shout; I simply start walking.

lines.zh: 这个方向有东西在喘气。
lines.en: Something is breathing in this direction.

lines.zh: 我锁定了，别指望我忘。
lines.en: I have locked on; do not hope I forget.

lines.zh: 你弄出的声音，把你自己卖了。
lines.en: The noise you make has sold you out.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，因为跑起来会吓跑你。
lines.en: I come slowly, because running would scare you off.

lines.zh: 你身上有伤，味道更甜。
lines.en: You're wounded. That makes the scent sweeter.

lines.zh: 树上的鸟全飞了，就剩你。
lines.en: Every bird has fled. Only you are left.

lines.zh: 我的目光钉在你身上，挪不开。
lines.en: My gaze is fixed on you and will not shift.

lines.zh: 你往左，我往左一点。
lines.en: You go left, and I lean left a little.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸变慢了，这是要动手了。
lines.en: My breathing slows; that means I am about to strike.

lines.zh: 你举盾，我照着你举盾的手打。
lines.en: You raise a shield, so I aim at the arm holding it.

lines.zh: 我在算距离，用脚量。
lines.en: I am measuring the distance with my feet.

lines.zh: 你退到水边，我看你还能退多远。
lines.en: You back to the water; I wonder how much farther you can go.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，肩膀先动。
lines.en: I lower myself and my shoulders move first.

lines.zh: 你喘得越来越急，我全听见了。
lines.en: Your breathing grows quicker and I hear all of it.

lines.zh: 我等你自己失误。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to make a mistake.

lines.zh: 林子里没有第二条路给你。
lines.en: The forest offers you no second path.

lines.zh: 我不绕圈，我直着来。
lines.en: I do not circle around; I come straight on.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在抖。
lines.en: The thing in your hand is trembling.

lines.zh: 我把重量压到前脚上。
lines.en: I shift my weight onto my front foot.

lines.zh: 还有一步的距离，我就动手。
lines.en: One pace of distance left, and then I strike.

lines.zh: 我把手掌在裤子上蹭干。
lines.en: I wipe my palms dry on my legs.

lines.zh: 你退到坡上，坡对我没差。
lines.en: You back up the slope. The slope doesn't matter to me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢直起身，比树还高。
lines.en: I straighten up slow, taller than the trees.

lines.zh: 你的盾牌太小，挡不住两边。
lines.en: Your shield is too small to cover both sides.

lines.zh: 我先动肩膀，这是信号。
lines.en: My shoulder moves first. That's the warning.

lines.zh: 我再走两步，你就没地方退了。
lines.en: Two more steps and you've nowhere left to back into.

lines.zh: 我的拳头落下，土都跳起来。
lines.en: My fist lands and the dirt jumps.

lines.zh: 这一下五点的力道，你记住了。
lines.en: Five points of force; remember it.

lines.zh: 我不用武器，手臂就够。
lines.en: I need no weapon; my arms will do.

lines.zh: 你挡了，可你还是退了。
lines.en: You blocked it, and you still staggered back.

lines.zh: 我打偏了，树替我挨了一下。
lines.en: I missed and a tree took the blow for you.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领，往地上按。
lines.en: I grab your collar and press you down.

lines.zh: 我的指甲划开你，很浅。
lines.en: My nails open you, but only shallowly.

lines.zh: 我打两下才停，因为我慢。
lines.en: I strike twice before stopping, because I am slow.

lines.zh: 你不该站在我手够得着的地方。
lines.en: You should not stand within my reach.

lines.zh: 这一拳把你打得连话都说不出。
lines.en: This blow knocks the words right out of you.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，然后才动手。
lines.en: I roar first, and then I strike.

lines.zh: 你打我一下，我打你三下。
lines.en: You hit me once; I hit you three times.

lines.zh: 我的力气全在身体里，没有别的。
lines.en: All my strength is in this body and nowhere else.

lines.zh: 打完，我等你站起来再来一次。
lines.en: When it is done, I wait for you to stand again.

lines.zh: 我这一拳打在你盾上，盾凹了。
lines.en: My fist lands on your shield. It dents.

lines.zh: 你的骨头响了一声，我知道哪根。
lines.en: One of your bones cracked. I know which.

lines.zh: 我拎起你，再放下，很轻。
lines.en: I lift you up and set you down. You're light.

lines.zh: 我用肩膀撞你，比拳头省力。
lines.en: I hit you with my shoulder. Less work than a fist.

lines.zh: 你从坡上滑下去，我没追。
lines.en: You slide down the slope. I don't follow.

lines.zh: 这一下够你躺一会儿了。
lines.en: That one will keep you down a while.

lines.zh: 我从针叶林深处站起来，抖掉雪。
lines.en: I rise deep in the taiga and shake off the snow.

lines.zh: 这片森林的生成权重是五十。
lines.en: This forest gives me a spawn weight of fifty.

lines.zh: 树影里多了一个比树矮的影。
lines.en: Among the tree shadows stands a shadow shorter than they are.

lines.zh: 我出生时，周围已经有很多同类。
lines.en: When I appeared, many of my kind were already around.

lines.zh: 我抓了一把苔藓，先吃了。
lines.en: I grab a handful of moss and eat it first.

lines.zh: 有猎人进了林子，可惜他不知道。
lines.en: A hunter has entered the woods, and does not know it yet.

lines.zh: 我的脚印从这一棵树下开始。
lines.en: My prints begin beneath this one tree.

lines.zh: 森林没有给我名字，我也不需要。
lines.en: The forest gave me no name and I need none.

lines.zh: 我第一次吼，鸟全飞了。
lines.en: At my first roar, every bird leaves.

lines.zh: 这地方树太多，我喜欢。
lines.en: Too many trees here; I like it.

lines.zh: 我闻着松脂味，算是到家了。
lines.en: I smell pine resin and consider myself home.

lines.zh: 天黑之前，我要先把这片地走一遍。
lines.en: Before dark I mean to walk this ground once.

lines.zh: 火燎着我的毛，味道很难闻。
lines.en: Fire singes my fur and the smell is foul.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下来，撞断两棵树。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and snap two trees.

lines.zh: 水没过我的胸口，我站不稳。
lines.en: Water reaches my chest and I cannot stand firm.

lines.zh: 响声把我掀翻，耳朵嗡嗡的。
lines.en: The blast throws me down and my ears ring.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进肩膀，我把它拔了。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder and I pull it out.

lines.zh: 紫色的东西钻进我的骨头。
lines.en: Something violet crawls into my bones.

lines.zh: 我饿得连吼都吼不响。
lines.en: I am so hungry my roar comes out thin.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我身上，毛全竖起来了。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and my fur stands up.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我只能乱抓。
lines.en: There is no ground and I claw at nothing.
